es.tpl.name: Nuevo cliente
es.tpl.description: Perfila al cliente, revisa contrato, facturación y capacidad en paralelo y prepara la bienvenida.
es.tpl.request: Dar de alta al nuevo cliente {{client}} ({{service}})
es.step.profile.title: Perfilar a {{client}}
es.step.profile.desc: Reunir datos del cliente {{client}}, alcance de {{service}} y contactos clave.
es.step.contract.title: Revisar contrato de {{client}}
es.step.contract.desc: Revisar cláusulas, responsabilidades y riesgos del contrato con {{client}}.
es.step.billing.title: Configurar facturación de {{client}}
es.step.billing.desc: Definir condiciones de pago, datos fiscales y calendario de facturación de {{client}}.
es.step.capacity.title: Validar capacidad para {{client}}
es.step.capacity.desc: Confirmar si hay capacidad operativa para entregar {{service}} a {{client}}.
es.step.welcome.title: Preparar bienvenida a {{client}}
es.step.welcome.desc: Consolidar lo anterior y redactar el correo de bienvenida y siguientes pasos para {{client}}.

en.tpl.name: New client
en.tpl.description: Profiles the client, reviews contract, billing and capacity in parallel, and prepares the welcome.
en.step.profile.title: Profile {{client}}
en.step.profile.desc: Gather client data for {{client}}, the scope of {{service}} and key contacts.
en.step.contract.title: Review {{client}} contract
en.step.contract.desc: Review clauses, liabilities and risks of the contract with {{client}}.
en.step.billing.title: Set up billing for {{client}}
en.step.billing.desc: Define payment terms, tax details and the invoicing calendar for {{client}}.
en.step.capacity.title: Check capacity for {{client}}
en.step.capacity.desc: Confirm there is operational capacity to deliver {{service}} to {{client}}.
en.step.welcome.title: Prepare welcome for {{client}}
en.step.welcome.desc: Consolidate the above and draft the welcome email and next steps for {{client}}.
